title: 3D portal test chamber with live HTML consoles and FBO sightlines
blurb: A 3D test chamber in WebGL 2 with live HTML wall controls, a Companion Cube and two portals backed by off-screen framebuffer cameras. Orbit the room, shoot portals onto any wall and launch the cube from Blue out of Orange.
question: Can a single WebGL 2 canvas render a 3D test chamber with live interactive HTML control panels and a live-HTML Companion Cube, shoot Blue and Orange portals onto walls, render a real secondary-camera portal view into an FBO so you see the live HTML console through the portal, and launch the cube from Blue out of Orange?
